explainer_content.short_definition: Hip-hop-era soul revival with organic texture, Black consciousness, and adult R&B depth.
explainer_content.history_capsule: Neo-soul emerged in the 1990s as artists reconnected R&B to 1970s soul, jazz, funk, and hip-hop while asserting album-scale identity.
explainer_content.why_it_mattered: It gave R&B a prestige album lane and influenced later alternative R&B, conscious rap, and adult soul.
explainer_content.what_made_it_distinct: The sound is warm and intentional, often resisting glossy R&B formulas in favor of musicianship and interiority.
